name: Echoes of a Turnabout: Franziska von Karma
source:
There's been a murder at the Gatewater Imperial Hotel, and Detective Dick Gumshoe's been arrested as the prime suspect! It's up to Franziska von Karma and Maya Fey to act on behalf of the snowed-in Wright Anything Agency to build a defense case for him!

[From [url=https://teamsnowcone.itch.io/turnaboutecho]itch.io[/url]]
